connectors.name: USB-A plug contacts
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; vertical row of PCB USB plug contacts, started at the top as displayed (the contacts are the USB connector itself)

notes: The only wiring points with individually labeled contacts are the four PCB USB-A plug contacts (GND, D+, D-, VBUS), included per rule 1 because each is labeled. Skipped: the TOUCH capacitive pad (1/A1, PA07, a touch sensing area rather than a pin), SDA (PA04) and SCL (PA05) which run to the on-board SHT45 sensor, and NEOPIXEL (PA03).
